long_biography.plain_text:
The George Economou Collection turns a private passion into a public-facing cultural institution in Athens. Economou began collecting in the 1990s, first concentrating on early twentieth-century European art before expanding into postwar and contemporary work. In 2012 he opened a dedicated exhibition space, where the collection stages shows and public programmes with international curators and institutions.

Its holdings are especially deep in German Expressionism and New Objectivity, including the graphic work of Otto Dix and Otto Mueller. Loans have brought those strengths to museums including Tate Modern, while Economou's board service with the Tate Foundation and Dia Art Foundation extends the connection beyond collecting. The result is a durable cultural dimension to a career otherwise defined by maritime enterprise.
